The invention relates to a spring support for a coil spring (15), comprising an annular receiving element (5) having a top side and a bottom side, wherein the top side is configured to receive one end of the coil spring (15). The spring support further comprises an annular damping element (3) in contact with the bottom side of the receiving element (5), wherein the damping element (3) additionally has, on its inner side, a collar extending from the bottom side of the receiving element (5) in the direction of the coil spring (15). The invention further relates to a method for producing a spring support according to the invention, wherein a disk-shaped damping element (3) is first placed in a casting mold, and an annular receiving element (5) is then produced by molding or injection molding onto the damping element (3), such that the bottom side of the receiving element (5) is in contact with the annular damping element (3).

The invention concerns a support for a coil spring (15). The support includes a ring-shaped receiving component (5) with an upper face and a lower face. The upper face is configured to accommodate one end of the coil spring (15). It also includes a ring-shaped damping component (3) that rests against the lower face of the receiving component (5). On its inner side, the damping component (3) additionally includes a collar extending from the lower face of the receiving component (5) toward the coil spring (15). This collar is produced by bending it out of an originally disk-shaped basic form of the damping component (3).

The invention also concerns a manufacturing method for producing such a spring support. In this method, a disk-shaped damping component (3) is initially positioned in a casting mold. The invention relates to a spring support for a coil spring. The spring support comprises an annular receiving element configured to receive and support one end of the coil spring. In use, the coil spring bears against the receiving element, so that forces from the spring can be transmitted through the spring support in a controlled manner.

The spring support further includes an annular damping element arranged on the bottom side of the receiving element. This damping element contacts the bottom side of the receiving element and serves to damp vibrations, reduce noise, and cushion loads transmitted between the coil spring and the adjacent supporting structure.

The damping element is provided with an inner collar. This collar extends from the bottom side of the receiving element in the direction of the coil spring. In this way, the collar can help guide or position the spring support relative to the coil spring and may also contribute to improved damping and stabilization of the spring end.

The inner collar is produced from the damping element itself. Starting from a disk-shaped basic form, the damping element is bent or shaped so that a portion of it forms the collar. This makes it possible to manufacture the damping element in a simple and material-efficient manner while still providing the desired annular damping region and the upwardly extending collar.

A corresponding production method is also described. In this method, a disk-shaped damping element is first placed into a casting mold. The annular receiving element is then molded or injection-molded onto the damping element. As a result, the receiving element and the damping element are joined together during the molding process, forming an integrated spring support with a receiving surface for the coil spring and a damping element arranged on its bottom side.
outputs.L4:
The invention relates to a spring support for supporting a coil spring, in particular in a vehicle suspension system. The spring support comprises an annular receiving element which is configured to receive and support an end region of the coil spring. A damping element is arranged on or in the receiving element in such a way that the coil spring is supported with damping and noise-reducing effect. The damping element has an inwardly directed collar which forms a contact and support region for the coil spring. This collar is produced by bending or shaping the damping element from an originally disk-shaped basic form, so that a simple and cost-effective component geometry can be obtained.

The annular receiving element may be made of a plastics material or another moldable material and is shaped to provide a stable seat for the coil spring. The damping element is preferably made of an elastomeric or resilient material and is positioned so that it lies between the coil spring and the receiving element at least in selected support regions. In this manner, forces introduced by the coil spring can be transmitted reliably into the receiving element while vibrations, impact loads, and noise are reduced. The inwardly bent collar of the damping element improves the positional securing of the spring end and provides an integrated damping surface in the region where the coil spring bears against the support.

The invention further relates to a method for producing such a spring support. In the method, the damping element is first provided in a disk-shaped basic form and is then shaped so as to form the inwardly extending collar. The damping element is placed into a mold, preferably in a defined position corresponding to its later functional arrangement. Subsequently, the receiving element is molded or injection-molded onto the damping element. During this process, the receiving element is formed around or against the damping element so that the two components are securely connected to one another.

This production method enables the damping element and the receiving element to be combined into a single integrated spring support component. As a result, additional assembly steps can be reduced or eliminated. The molded connection also ensures accurate positioning of the damping element relative to the receiving element, thereby improving functional reliability. The resulting spring support provides both a stable receiving structure for the coil spring and an effective damping interface, making it suitable for applications in which compact construction, durability, and reduced noise transmission are desired.
outputs.L5:
**The Power of “The”**

“The” is one of the smallest words in the English language, yet it plays a very important role. It is called a definite article, and we use it when we are talking about something specific. For example, “a book” could mean any book, but “the book” means a particular book that both the speaker and listener know about.

This simple word helps make communication clearer. It points to people, places, objects, and ideas that are already known or unique. We say “the sun” because there is only one sun in our sky, and “the teacher” when we know which teacher is being discussed.

Although “the” may seem ordinary, it appears constantly in English writing and speech. It connects ideas, gives sentences structure, and helps readers understand meaning. Without it, English would sound less natural and much less precise.

In short, “the” is a small word with a big purpose. It proves that even the simplest parts of language can be essential.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style summary for an invention involving a spring support for a coil spring with an annular receiving element and an annular damping element having an inward collar formed by bending.
counterfactuals.output:
## Summary

The invention relates to a spring support for a coil spring, in particular for use in a vehicle suspension system. The spring support comprises an annular receiving element configured to receive and support an end region of the coil spring, and an annular damping element arranged on the receiving element for elastically damping forces transmitted between the coil spring and the receiving element.

The damping element is formed as an annular body and includes an inwardly directed collar. The collar is produced by bending a portion of the damping element radially inward, thereby forming a defined support and/or retaining region for the coil spring. The inward collar may engage beneath, around, or adjacent to an inner side of the receiving element or the spring end, so as to improve positioning of the damping element and reduce displacement during operation.

By forming the collar through bending, the damping element can be manufactured in a simple and cost-effective manner while providing reliable retention and damping performance. The annular receiving element may be made of metal or a rigid structural material, while the annular damping element may comprise an elastomeric or resilient material suitable for isolating vibrations, reducing noise, and compensating for tolerances between the coil spring and the receiving element.

In one embodiment, the receiving element defines an annular seat for the coil spring, and the damping element is arranged between the seat and the coil spring. The inwardly bent collar extends radially inward from a main annular portion of the damping element and may at least partially cover an inner edge of the receiving element. This configuration helps prevent direct contact between the coil spring and the receiving element, thereby reducing wear and improving acoustic behavior.

The invention further provides a spring assembly including the spring support and a coil spring supported thereon. The spring support enables improved mounting reliability, enhanced damping of spring forces, and simplified production compared with arrangements requiring separately attached retaining components.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Write the “invention relates to” section for a patent application describing a coil spring support, including both the structural features and a production method using molding or injection molding.
counterfactuals.output:
The invention relates to a coil spring support, in particular for supporting and/or locating a coil spring relative to an adjacent component, such as a vehicle body, chassis component, suspension arm, damper assembly, machine frame, or other spring seat. The coil spring support comprises a support body configured to receive an end region of a coil spring and to transmit spring forces from the coil spring to the adjacent component. The support body may include a spring-receiving surface, seat, groove, recess, projection, centering portion, retaining portion, and/or abutment surface shaped to cooperate with one or more turns of the coil spring, thereby positioning the coil spring in a defined orientation and reducing relative displacement during use.

The coil spring support may be formed at least partially from an elastomeric, polymeric, thermoplastic, thermoset, or composite material and may be configured to provide cushioning, vibration damping, noise reduction, load distribution, and/or protection against wear between the coil spring and the component on which the spring is supported. In some embodiments, the coil spring support includes reinforcing structures, ribs, wall portions, inserts, sleeves, attachment formations, or mounting openings for securing the coil spring support to the adjacent component or for improving dimensional stability under load.

The invention further relates to a method for producing such a coil spring support. The method comprises providing a mold having a cavity corresponding to the desired shape of the coil spring support, introducing a moldable material into the mold cavity, and curing, cooling, solidifying, or otherwise setting the material to form the support body. The material may be introduced by molding, compression molding, transfer molding, overmolding, or injection molding. In an injection-molding embodiment, a polymeric or elastomeric material is injected into the mold cavity under pressure, optionally around one or more inserts or reinforcement elements positioned in the mold, and is then allowed to solidify before the formed coil spring support is removed from the mold. The production method may further include post-processing steps such as trimming, surface finishing, forming attachment features, applying coatings, or inspecting the geometry of the spring-receiving surface.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Formulate a German-style translated patent claim summary about a spring support for a coil spring, with reference numerals (15), (5), and (3), and include a manufacturing method.
counterfactuals.output:
**Patentanspruchszusammenfassung (deutscher Stil)**

1. **Federauflage für eine Schraubenfeder**, insbesondere für ein Fahrwerks- oder Dämpfersystem, umfassend einen Federauflagekörper **(15)** zur Abstützung eines Endabschnitts einer Schraubenfeder, wobei der Federauflagekörper **(15)** eine Aufnahmefläche für die Schraubenfeder aufweist und mit einem Trägerelement **(5)** verbindbar oder daran angeordnet ist, dadurch gekennzeichnet, dass der Federauflagekörper **(15)** eine an die Kontur der Schraubenfeder angepasste Stützgeometrie aufweist, durch welche eine definierte Lagefixierung und Kraftübertragung zwischen der Schraubenfeder und dem Trägerelement **(5)** ermöglicht wird.

2. **Federauflage nach Anspruch 1**, wobei der Federauflagekörper **(15)** wenigstens einen Anschlag- oder Führungsabschnitt aufweist, der ein Verdrehen oder seitliches Verschieben der Schraubenfeder relativ zu dem Trägerelement **(5)** begrenzt.

3. **Federauflage nach einem der vorhergehenden Ansprüche**, wobei zwischen dem Federauflagekörper **(15)** und einem Grundkörper oder Befestigungsabschnitt **(3)** eine formschlüssige, kraftschlüssige und/oder stoffschlüssige Verbindung ausgebildet ist.

4. **Federauflage nach einem der vorhergehenden Ansprüche**, wobei der Federauflagekörper **(15)** aus einem elastomeren, polymeren oder metallischen Werkstoff besteht oder eine Beschichtung zur Geräusch- und Schwingungsdämpfung aufweist.

5. **Verfahren zur Herstellung einer Federauflage für eine Schraubenfeder**, insbesondere einer Federauflage nach einem der Ansprüche 1 bis 4, umfassend die Schritte:
   - Bereitstellen eines Trägerelements **(5)** oder eines Grundkörpers **(3)**,
   - Herstellen oder Formen eines Federauflagekörpers **(15)** mit einer an die Schraubenfeder angepassten Aufnahmefläche,
   - Verbinden des Federauflagekörpers **(15)** mit dem Trägerelement **(5)** und/oder dem Grundkörper **(3)** durch Spritzgießen, Umspritzen, Kleben, Vulkanisieren, Verschweißen, Verpressen oder eine formschlüssige Montage,
   - Ausbilden wenigstens eines Führungs- oder Anschlagbereichs zur Positionierung der Schraubenfeder.

6. **Verfahren nach Anspruch 5**, wobei der Federauflagekörper **(15)** unmittelbar auf das Trägerelement **(5)** oder den Grundkörper **(3)** aufgebracht und dabei dauerhaft mit diesem verbunden wird.

counterfactuals.prompt: Create a technical patent description paragraph for an annular spring seat with a damping element whose inner collar is bent upward from a disk-shaped basic form.
counterfactuals.output: An annular spring seat for supporting a coil spring comprises a substantially disk-shaped basic body having a central opening and an annular support region configured to receive an end turn of the coil spring. A damping element is arranged on or integrally formed with the basic body and is made of an elastomeric or otherwise vibration-damping material. The damping element includes an inner collar which, starting from the disk-shaped basic form, is bent or folded upward in an axial direction around the central opening. The upwardly bent inner collar forms a circumferential guide and centering surface for positioning the spring seat relative to an adjacent component, while also providing radial and axial damping between the spring seat and the adjacent component. By forming the inner collar from the disk-shaped basic form, the damping element can be produced with a simple geometry and subsequently shaped to provide an axially projecting collar, thereby improving installation stability, reducing vibration transmission, and preventing direct contact between metallic components.
